title: Tarnished Charm
summary: Reduces death saving throw DC from 10 to 5.

fields.Fey Life: While worn, a death save of 5 meets the DC.
fields.Acquisition: Loot Auntie Ethel. Leaving the amulet on her body changes her responses when you cast Speak with Dead on it.
fields.Base value: 65 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
